<!--
Thanks for stepping forward!

When you adopt a locale you become the named co-maintainer for that
file. You get review credit on any future PR touching it, and your
name in the README's Translation contributors section.
-->

### Which locale?

Which locale would you like to maintain? Replace `xx_XX` below.

- Locale: `xx_XX`

### About you (optional but helpful)

- Are you a native speaker of this language? Yes / No
- Do you use Stable Diffusion regularly? Yes / No
- How would you like to be credited?
  (e.g. GitHub handle only, real name + handle, real name only)

### Anything specific you'd want to fix first?

If you've already spotted things you'd want to clean up in the
existing translation, list them here — even rough notes are fine.

### Next steps

Once I see this issue, I'll add you as a recognised maintainer for
the locale in the README and welcome any PR you open against the
relevant JSON file. No formal commitment — you contribute when and
how you can.

Thank you 🙏
